main_body: Roofed well: a snow-covered roof on two wooden posts over a stone well base with a dark water opening, a bucket and a rope
top_band: Grey-blue stone rim with a dark opening ellipse beneath it (rows ~15-22). The snow roof above is a white top band (rows ~1-8), and the front face below is stone (rows ~23-30).
evidence: Down the middle column: snow roof top band, icicles, posts and rope, then the stone rim and a dark elliptical opening with a bucket. A lighter front rim edge ends the opening. Below it the stone front face has dark course lines and a darker band directly under the rim. The opening is clearly seen from above as an ellipse and reads like the reference well. The front stone courses are mostly painted lines rather than inset, but the top surfaces and the front face are both clearly drawn.

style.evidence: The snow roof has about 4-5 steps (white, pale blue, blue-grey, shadow) with icicles and clumpy edges. The wood posts have 3 tones, and the stone base has 3-4 greys with course lines and some speckle. Outlines lean toward dark blue-grey and brown, so they are tinted rather than black. The dark opening and the stone rows are fairly flat in places, so density is a little below the reference. Overall it is acceptable next to the roofed-well reference.
